staticText: Local one-way typing aid using unverified deterministic subsets: 21 Ethiopic base rows with 7 orders (147 forms), 26 Neo-Tifinagh tokens and 30 Arabic tokens. N'Ko and Vai are not offered because the previous route tables did not map the advertised Latin tokens to the correct Unicode letters or syllables. The Arabic mapping is not Arabic or Ajami translation. Ethiopic and Tifinagh results do not select a language-specific standard orthography. No mapping promises phonetic accuracy, dialect coverage, preserved meaning or a reversible round trip. Copy, TXT and print-to-PDF stay local and raw input is not persisted or sent.
